title: Product report
summaryDiscounted: None was discounted. | {count} was discounted, giving {discount} away in discounts. | {count} were discounted, giving {discount} away in discounts.

rules.restock: It sells well (popular or class A) and its stock is out or too short.
rules.discontinue: It sold nothing, or it is unpopular and class C.
rules.reprice: It sells well but earns little per unit: a workhorse.
rules.watch: It is unpopular without being class A.
rules.keep: It sells and its stock is enough: nothing to do.
rules.too_early: Not enough orders since it arrived, or under half of the period's orders: too early to judge.

reasons.too_few_orders: Only {orders} orders since it arrived: {enough} are needed to judge.
reasons.arrived_late: It arrived late and saw only {orders} orders, under half of the period's {half}.
reasons.nothing_sold: No unit sold in the period.
reasons.unpopular_tail: It sells little ({pace} per 100 orders, limit {limit}) and is among those earning the least (class C).
reasons.sold_out: It sells well ({pace} per 100 orders) and none is left in stock.
reasons.sold_out_top_earner: It sells little ({pace} per 100 orders, limit {limit}) but earns a lot (class A), and none is left in stock.
reasons.low_cover: It sells well ({pace} per 100 orders), but the stock lasts only {cover} orders, less than the {orders} of {event}.
reasons.low_cover_top_earner: It sells little ({pace} per 100 orders, limit {limit}) but earns a lot (class A), and the stock lasts only {cover} orders, less than the {orders} of {event}.
reasons.workhorse: It sells well ({pace} per 100 orders) but earns {margin} per unit, under the limit of {limit}.
reasons.unpopular: It sells little ({pace} per 100 orders, limit {limit}) without being among the top earners.
reasons.top_earner: It sells little ({pace} per 100 orders, limit {limit}) but earns a lot (class A).
reasons.fine: It sells well ({pace} per 100 orders), earns {margin} per unit and its stock is enough.

how.title: How it is calculated
how.pace: The pace is the number of units sold per 100 orders placed while it was on sale: since it arrived, or only until its last sale when it is sold out.
how.unitMargin: The margin per unit is what was cashed minus the buying cost, divided by the units sold.
how.classes: Products are ranked by margin. Class A: those making the first {a}% of the margin. Class B: up to {b}%. Class C: all the rest.

quadrants.star: Star: sells well and earns a lot per unit.
quadrants.workhorse: Workhorse: sells well but earns little per unit.
quadrants.puzzle: Puzzle: sells little but earns a lot per unit.
quadrants.dog: Dog: sells little and earns little per unit.

how.cover: "Lasts N orders": the units in stock × the orders placed while it was on sale ÷ the units sold, rounded down.
how.lowStock: Low stock: it lasts fewer orders than {event} had ({orders}).
how.margin: The margin is what was cashed minus the buying cost of the units sold.
how.discounted: Discounted: a unit sold whose order line carries a share of a discount.
how.fullPrice: Full price: a unit sold without any share of a discount.
